name: Gourmet Master Co. Ltd.
summary: Gourmet Master Co. Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates and franchises chain stores in China, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. The company operates cafes that serve bread, cake, drinks, souvenirs, selected ingredients, and raw donuts under the 85°C brand. It also engages in investment; production and sale of bakery products; retail sale of groceries and beverages; trading and wholesale; and wholesale of beverages and bakery machinery. Gourmet Master Co. Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.
